storeCopy.seoTitle: Instagram User Reels Scraper | Public Videos
storeCopy.seoDescription: Collect Instagram Reels by username with captions, views, likes, comments, audio, and links. Batch public accounts and follow cursor pages for more videos.
storeCopy.intro: Collect public Reels from Instagram accounts with captions, engagement counts, posting times, author details, and media links. Add usernames in one run and page through available results.
useCases: Social analysts can compare Reel views and engagement across public accounts.
Creator managers can export recent video links and captions by username.
Researchers can track public Instagram video publishing activity over time.
howToUse: Add one public Instagram username to `usernames` for each account.
Set `maxPages` to bound cursor pages requested per account.
Use `maxResults` to limit the combined dataset size.

faqs.question: Can I search by numeric user ID instead?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can provide `user_id` as an optional input, while each batch entry still needs a username for the account label.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Numeric Instagram media identifier for the Reel.

fields.name: shortcode
fields.description: Short code used in the public Instagram Reel URL.

fields.name: media_type
fields.description: Instagram media type label for the Reel.

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Caption text published with the Reel.

fields.name: hashtags
fields.description: Hashtags extracted from the Reel caption.

fields.name: taken_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 time when the Reel was posted, when reported.

fields.name: taken_at_timestamp
fields.description: Unix timestamp when the Reel was posted.

fields.name: like_count
fields.description: Number of likes reported for the Reel.

fields.name: comment_count
fields.description: Number of comments reported for the Reel.

fields.name: play_count
fields.description: Number of Reel plays reported by Instagram, when available.

fields.name: view_count
fields.description: Number of Reel views reported by Instagram, when available.

fields.name: media
fields.description: Media assets associated with the Reel, including video and image URLs.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Location attached to the Reel, or null when none is reported.

fields.name: author
fields.description: Public profile details for the account that posted the Reel.

fields.name: collaborators
fields.description: Public accounts credited as Reel collaborators, when present.

fields.name: tagged_users
fields.description: Public accounts tagged in the Reel, when present.

fields.name: is_paid_partnership
fields.description: True when Instagram marks the Reel as a paid partnership.

fields.name: product_type
fields.description: Instagram publishing format for this Reel.

fields.name: permalink
fields.description: Public Instagram URL for the Reel.

fields.name: author_id
fields.description: Instagram identifier for the Reel author.

fields.name: author_username
fields.description: Public handle of the account that posted the Reel.

fields.name: author_verified
fields.description: True when Instagram marks the Reel author as verified.

fields.name: input_username
fields.description: Instagram username used to retrieve this account’s posts.

fields.name: scraped_at
fields.description: UTC date and time when this record was collected.
